attribution_limitations: The source does not make clear whether the age of 26 refers to the time of the offense or to the sentencing.
The authors state it is unclear how continuous the treatment and intake of antipsychotic agents was in the 1990s.
The case files are described as vague on therapeutic strategies; the extent to which psychotherapeutic concepts were implemented is unclear.

The index offense is not explicitly identified as the deliberate killing for which he was sentenced.
